notes: Description says the deck went 4-0 at the recent SC State Championships; Brad Reinhold won the 2001 South Carolina State Championship (his Light post, DeckTech 16256), so finish is 1st (4-0 with this deck).
Strategy: 'I took out the senses and put in The Circle is Now Complete, another Put All Sections On Alert, and Weapon Levitation in the one I ran at States' — the posted list is kept as published.

Objective posted as 'SYCFA/TUPITG' dested Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe. The strategy says he starts Crush The Rebellion, Oppressive Enforcement and Battle Order; three Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty. All count toward the 60.
Oppressive Enforcement and Come Here You Big Coward are 2001 Special Edition Effects (not Defensive Shields).
